title: Victoria International Kizomba Festival 8th Edition
description:
What to expect?? Locally and Internationally renowned instructors, teaching: Kizomba, Urban Kiz, Konpa, Bachata, Salsa, Tarraxo, Douceur, Afro Beat, Afro House and More!
ALL IN ONE:
Over 27.000 square feet of space
4 ROOMS:
– BACHATA ROOM (Bachata Sensual, Bachata Dominican, Bachazouk, Salsa)
– KIZOMBA (Kizomba, Semba, Konpa)
– URBAN KIZ (Urban, Tarraxho, Ghetto Zouk)
– VIBE ROOM (Konpa, Salsa, Afro Beats, Reggaeton, Hip Hop and More…)
VIKF 8th Edition is offering you:
*4 days of workshops
*3 day-time socials
*4 nights of dancing,
*30Hours + of workshops
*40H + of dancing
* 2 educational sessions of Cultural Aspect of African dances
* 1 Gala Night of celebration of Multiculturalism, Diversity, the Arts including performances and fashion shows by African Designers
IMPORTANT NOTICE: This 4 Day Festival has some free components offered to the general public as well as
some activities with a minimal cost (to be announced at a later date)
FULL PASS INCLUDES All Workshops, Day Socials and Parties (but does not includes Advanced Special trainings, Bootcamps and Master Classes)
